scope: Frozen-model scene transfer and temporal error diagnostic; no fitting on these sequences
temporal_definition: RMSE of (log1p(output)-log1p(independent reference)) minus the previous error reprojected onto the same static surface. Bilinear previous sampling; reject ID, position, normal or screen mismatch. Sampling noise remains.
limitations: Static geometry, moving camera and one area light
Geometric markings rather than texture decals
No exposure transitions, animated objects, vegetation or engine integration
No retraining or model selection on these test sequences
CPU reference only; no GPU or complete-frame performance result
Temporal correspondence excludes boundaries and unmatched surfaces; regional errors are reported separately

plan.scope: Frozen-model scene transfer and temporal error diagnostic; no fitting on these sequences
plan.acceptance: For each sequence, lower mean independent-reference log1p RMSE and mean reprojected temporal error than identity; report regional regressions and reference sampling noise separately. No perceptual or gameplay pass is inferred.
